text_block_list.text:
—Umamusume.
They hone their legs and relentlessly push the limits of possibility.
(Waaaaaah...!)

Sometimes inspiring dreams, sometimes giving courage...
Umamusume evolve with each passing day, moment by moment.
There is a single summit they all strive to reach—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaah...!!
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Duramente! Duramente takes the victory!!
She is just too strong, far too strong!
Once again this year, she dominates the stage completely!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...All right!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And if Duramente wins today...
she has declared that she will take on
that race she has continued to set her sights on!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Which means, in other words...!
It's finally...!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
To everyone here in the stands, beyond the screen...
and all around the world, I ask you this.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Am I the strongest?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: The strongest in Japan, huh?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Am I worthy... of shouldering the title of the world's strongest?
(Uwooooooah!)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
In that case, it's settled.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Let's challenge it.
—The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red and Yellow Hair Ornament
text_block_list.text:
Wah...!
Duramente-senpai, at long last...!

text_block_list.name: Star-Marked Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"She really is so cool...!
We need to get results on the Tiara path and catch up to our senior, too!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red and Yellow Hair Ornament
text_block_list.text:
Right!
I'm definitely going to win the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Emblem Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Duramente-san.
I want to follow in your footsteps too..."

text_block_list.name: Emblem Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, I'll follow in their footsteps!
I will seize a major title...!

—The challenge never ends.
Feelings turn into hope, passed on and connected.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wooow, look at that!
Everyone's on fire!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still, Dura-san is
definitely still our rival!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You're right. That's all the more reason... she has to come back as the strongest in the world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: If I defeat Duramente-san, then I'm the strongest! There's no easier game than this, la♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dura-saaaan!!
You've gotta win and come back safe, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Let's change history, and then...
let's set off some massive fireworks
together in Japan, too!"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
Duramenteeeee!
Go get 'emーー!!

On the day Duramente was set to leave for her overseas campaign,
a massive crowd of racing fans packed the airport.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
This year, make Japan's long-cherished dream come true...!
Bring home the victory!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Go out there and show the whole world the strength of Japanese Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text: —Dura.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Dad!
Big Sis Groove, too...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...It looks like words of encouragement
won't be necessary.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mother, myself, my juniors...
Everyone is counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Do your best, Dura.
...Good luck.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text: Dura...

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text:
Let me say once more
what I told you before the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Father
text_block_list.text: You are the strongest. I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――Ah.
An airplane...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Duramente has finally arrived—at a brand new, unwritten future.
And so this year, once again, a single Umamusume—shouldering hopes forged over countless ages—challenges a single peak.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
choice_data_list: We've finally made it, haven't we?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: My heart is ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I can feel my heart
pumping blood throughout my entire body.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's feelings...
have driven me all the way here.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Your feelings, too...
are running through this blood.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"No... you could say it is the very heart
that keeps me alive."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Are you ready in your heart?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Let's begin a new history.
Shouldering those hopes and stepping out into the world, her name was—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Pride sleeps within this blood.
What is meant to dwell here is..."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ――"The Strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: From this day forth, nowhere in history will there be anyone who does not know me... who does not know us.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I am Duramente—
The Umamusume who will conquer the world today.
